name: Notion
description: Ports agentic-workspace's generic Notion MCP integration into aw-workspace: stores a Notion internal-integration token in the zero-knowledge secret store and generates the mcp.json entry (@notionhq/notion-mcp-server) that MCP Gateway scans, so any agent running in the workspace gets Notion tools through the gateway.

skills.description: How to use the Notion MCP tools exposed through MCP Gateway once this app is installed and a token is saved — tool overview, page/database IDs, what needs to be shared with the integration first.

notion_token.description: Notion internal integration secret (from notion.so/profile/integrations, starts with ntn_ or secret_). Never stored in plain config — routed to the zero-knowledge secret store via POST /api/apps/notion/settings, same pattern as aw-app-git's github_token. The integration also needs each page/database it should see shared with it from Notion's own ‘Connect to integration’ UI — a token alone grants no access.

apps.reason: Notion contributes an mcp.json definition (the 'notion' MCP server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace installs/loads mcp-gateway before notion so the gateway can scan notion/mcp.json.
